notes.title: Community Update #9 Taverna updated to Godot 4.4
notes.content:
Greetings, Travelers!

With the release of Godot 4.4 at the beginning of March, we decided it was the right moment to update Taverna to the latest tech.

What are the improvements? There's a lot on the table.

Jolt physics engine has been officially included into the engine (it was an extension before), this will allow us in the future to add physics prediction easily to the game, that will reduce noticeably latency as client while interacting with objects. It will not come soon, but we already have done some tests and it's going to be amazing.

Shaders stutters are almost solved now. With the introduction of ubershaders, compiling will be only occur a couple of times, so the overall initial experience is going to be improved.

A new tonemapping has been introduced: AgX. We are still experimenting with it, but as it stands it's a nice graphical improvement with no performance costs. 

Physics interpolation. Finally it arrived for 3D as well. It will allow us to further reduce CPU load as we can easily drop the physics tick to something like 10-15 (from 30). It only effects the server, but it's a nice performance improvements for lower-end pcs.

UID (Unique idenfifier) has been extended to scripts and shaders. The absence of this massive necessary feature has been crippling the project for a while now and it's been solved. What it means is faster iterations on debugging and refactoring. Without this feature, refactoring on specific scripts has been impossibile.

https://i.imgur.com/a6hyfzt.png
from Sithoid on Discord 💗

All this will come in the next update, available for all in the demo. 

Thanks for all the feedback sent, work is being done and we appreciate so much every one of you taking the time to write to us.

See you in Taverna!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/hvPkJrqQRX

notes.title: Community Update #5 Role-Play!
notes.content:
Greetings, Travelers!

Today, we’re talking about role-play. Roles are an important part of Taverna, as we see them as a way to give meaning to your character and provide an incipit to your story in the tavern.

Once you join a tavern, you will be able to choose your role. Depending on your choice, you will spawn with specific items (or more than one), and your role name will be displayed on the nameplate above your character.

Roles are divided into two categories: Adventurers (customers) and Staff.
As of now, we plan to include the following roles in the game:

Adventurers:

 Fortune Teller 
 Gambler 
 Blind 
 Hobo 
 Traveler 
 Bard 
 Flutist 
 Artist 
 Priest 
 Merchant
 The Drunk
 The Mute
Staff:

 Chef
 Cook 
 Stock Keeper 
 Waiter 
 Owner 
 Stoker 
 Bouncer

Since we’re still in development, the only playable role in the demo will be Traveler.

https://i.imgur.com/6SD7O6g.jpeg

What role would you like to play in Taverna? Tell us on Discord!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/hvPkJrqQRX

Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1596615319/taverna-online-fantasy-roleplay-game
